name: Onyxia
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/onyxia/onyxia.md and the cross-check pass where the sources agree. Onyxia is immune to Taunt in the real fight: the tank's one button here is a threat burst (think Sunder + Revenge + Heroic Strike dumped at once) that plays the same role as a Taunt in every other encounter, so the lesson is still when to press it. Cadences are DBM/BigWigs variance timers; Knock Away is the -25% threat knockback, Wing Buffet knocks back without a threat cut. Placeholders: cone angles (60 front / 120 rear: no Blizzard data, vmangos default arc), knockback distances (derived from the emulator knock-back formula: ~39 / 25 / 47 yd, clamped here to 30 / 22 / 35), Deep Breath as an instant lane rather than a travelling wall and on a compressed cadence (real: a 30-35% roll every 15-25 s, so 0-2 per phase), whelp waves despawning after 30 s, Fireball threat wipes folded into the landing reset, melee damage ~600 per swing (one 2005 figure). Ranged and healer pockets are the NE/NW corners of the back wall per the Classic wiki and Warcraft Tavern. Tank health is 12,000 here (a placeholder): with casts now queueing behind one another rather than being dropped, Flame Breath, Wing Buffet and melee can land together, and there are no mitigation buttons to answer that with.

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Onyxia cannot be taunted: this is your biggest threat dump (Sunder, Revenge, Heroic Strike at once). Press it the moment she turns on the raid or lands, never while she is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls her off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: Big heals on the tank. Pre-heal before Flame Breath and the landing.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Remove a dispellable debuff from the raid.

flameBreath.label: Flame Breath
flameBreath.tip: 2 s cast, 3063-3937 Fire in a 45 yd cone. Only the tank stands in it.

wingBuffet.label: Wing Buffet
wingBuffet.tip: 1 s cast, 20 yd frontal cone: 563-937 damage and a long knockback. No threat loss. With the wall behind you it goes nowhere.

fireball.label: Fireball
fireball.tip: 3 s cast on a random player (often the tank), 1700-2300 Fire to everyone within 8 yd, and the target's threat is wiped. Here the wipes are folded into the landing threat reset. Spread.

deepBreath.label: Deep Breath
deepBreath.tip: "Onyxia takes in a deep breath..." then 5 s before a wall of fire crosses the room from her position to the opposite side. Move to the side adjacent to her.

whelpWave.label: Whelps
whelpWave.tip: Whelps pour from both egg pits. The whelp groups hold them at the pit mouths. (They do not despawn in the real fight; here each wave dies after 30 s so the sim stays readable.)

bellowingRoar.label: Bellowing Roar
bellowingRoar.tip: 1.5 s cast, 3 s fear on everyone in the room. The lava cracks erupt right after it.

eruption.label: Eruption
eruption.tip: After each Bellowing Roar the floor cracks erupt for a few seconds: ~1500 Fire per hit.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: Someone overtakes the tank on threat.

knockAway.label: Knock Away
knockAway.tip: Instant: knocks the tank back and cuts their threat by a quarter. Back to the wall or she turns.

whelpTrickle.label: Whelps
whelpTrickle.tip: Whelps pour from both egg pits. The whelp groups hold them at the pit mouths.

expectations.label: Pull Onyxia to the back wall
expectations.tip: Pull straight to the back wall. Run up the ramp, through the raid, and keep going until your back is on the wall.

expectations.label: Keep her facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Stand between Onyxia and the wall so she faces the wall. If she turns, move so that you are on the far side from the raid.

expectations.label: Be against the wall for Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: Wing Buffet knocks you back. With the wall behind you there is nowhere to go, and she stays put.

expectations.label: Keep her on you after Knock Away
expectations.tip: Knock Away throws you back and cuts a quarter of your threat. Back to the wall at once, and burst threat the moment she turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Take her back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Someone will pull aggro. Watch the threat bar and the warning: the moment she turns, burst threat. Every second she faces the raid is a Flame Breath waiting to happen.

expectations.label: Stay out of her front
expectations.tip: Flame Breath and Cleave hit everything in front of her. Stand at her flank or behind the raid, never between her and the tank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Keep your threat under two thirds of the tank's: when the bar goes red, stop attacking until it clears. A Knock Away takes a quarter of the tank's threat away in one hit.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Flame Breath hits the tank for a big chunk. Have a heal landing as the cast finishes, and never let the tank sit under half.

expectations.label: Be on the pickup spot when she lands
expectations.tip: In Phase 2 your job is to be ready for the landing. Stand on the pickup spot north of the centre, dodge the lane, and come straight back.

expectations.label: Stay out of the Deep Breath lane
expectations.tip: Deep Breath is a five second warning. Step sideways out of the lane, do not run along it.

expectations.label: Pick up the whelp wave
expectations.tip: Whelps come from both caves. Meet them near the centre so you catch both packs, then walk them away from the raid.

expectations.label: Keep whelps off the raid
expectations.tip: Hold the whelps at the west pit mouth, well away from the healers.

expectations.label: Stay out of the Deep Breath lane
expectations.tip: Deep Breath is a five second warning. Step sideways out of the lane, do not run along it.

expectations.label: Pick her up within 5s of landing
expectations.tip: The moment she lands, burst threat. Stay on her for a few seconds so she settles on you before you move.

expectations.label: Drag her back to the wall
expectations.tip: Walk backwards toward the wall in a straight line so she follows without turning toward the raid.

expectations.label: Keep her facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Stand between Onyxia and the wall so she faces the wall.

expectations.label: Get her off the raid after Bellowing Roar
expectations.tip: The fear runs you off her. The moment it ends, get back between her and the raid so she is on you and facing away from them, then walk her back onto the wall.

expectations.label: Never stand on an eruption crack
expectations.tip: The cracks erupt right after each Bellowing Roar, for a few seconds. Walk between them, and keep the wall spot clear of cracks.

expectations.label: Be against the wall for Wing Buffet
expectations.tip: Back on the wall before each Buffet.

expectations.label: Keep her on you after Knock Away
expectations.tip: Knock Away throws you back and cuts a quarter of your threat. Back to the wall at once, and burst threat the moment she turns toward the raid.

expectations.label: Take her back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Someone will pull aggro. Watch the threat bar and the warning: the moment she turns, burst threat. Every second she faces the raid is a Flame Breath waiting to happen.

expectations.label: Stay out of her front
expectations.tip: Flame Breath and Cleave hit everything in front of her. Stand at her flank or behind the raid, never between her and the tank.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Keep your threat under two thirds of the tank's: when the bar goes red, stop attacking until it clears. A Knock Away takes a quarter of the tank's threat away in one hit.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Flame Breath hits the tank for a big chunk. Have a heal landing as the cast finishes, and never let the tank sit under half.

expectations.label: Let the tank pick her up before you attack
expectations.tip: Her threat table is empty when she lands. Do nothing until she is on the tank, then build slowly.

threatLostCount.label: Times she turned on the raid

pickupTime.label: Time to pick up after landing

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull her. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had her
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled her before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or she is not on the tank.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before Flame Breath lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the breath.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

drills.name: Pull and Wing Buffet
drills.description: Pull from the ramp to the wall, then hold position through three Wing Buffets and burst threat her back if she turns.

drills.name: When to burst threat
drills.description: Already at the wall. DPS keep pulling aggro and Wing Buffet cuts your threat. burst threat her back the instant she turns, never before.

drills.name: Bellowing Roar recovery
drills.description: Already at the wall in Phase 3. Each Roar fears you off her. Get back between her and the raid and walk her onto the wall before she turns.

drills.name: Phase 3 pickup
drills.description: She lands in five seconds. burst threat, pick her up, and drag her to the wall between the cracks.

drills.name: Threat discipline
drills.description: Already on her. Attack on every global but stop when the bar goes red: Wing Buffets cut the tank's threat and a landing resets it.

drills.name: Healing through Flame Breath
drills.description: Already on her. Keep the tank above half through a Breath every 14 seconds; wasted heals count against you.

steps.title: Onyxia's Lair
steps.text:
This is Onyxia's Lair. You came down the ramp from the south. The raid will gather in the centre. The back wall is where you will tank her.

Press Tab to switch between the top-down map and the over-the-shoulder view.

steps.title: Move to the tank spot
steps.text:
Move with W A S D. Q and E strafe. Hold the right mouse button to turn with the mouse. Space jumps.

Follow the glowing path and the ghost tank to the tank spot on the back wall.

steps.title: Pull and position
steps.text:
Onyxia faces whoever she is attacking. Walk to her, press your threat burst (1), then walk back to the wall. She will follow you and face the wall, away from the raid.

Stay in melee range: your threat builds on its own while you are on her. Dotted outlines show where she should stand and face.

steps.title: When to burst threat
steps.text:
The threat bar shows how close the raid is to pulling her off you. When someone does, she turns on the raid and a red burst threat note marked NOW drops into the lane above your bar.

your threat burst (1) the moment she turns. Pressing it early wastes the cooldown; pressing it late costs the raid a Flame Breath.

steps.title: Flame Breath
steps.text:
Flame Breath is a two second cast that hits a cone in front of her. You take it. The raid must not.

Hold your position between her and the wall and let it land on you.

steps.title: Wing Buffet and Knock Away
steps.text:
Wing Buffet knocks you back a long way. With the wall behind you the knockback goes nowhere. Knock Away is the one that also cuts a quarter of your threat.

After either lands, get straight back into melee range so your threat rebuilds, and burst threat if she turns.

steps.title: Phase 2: airborne
steps.text: At 65% she takes off. Fireballs hit random raid members. Move to the pickup spot north of the centre and wait.

steps.title: Deep Breath
steps.text: Deep Breath has a five second warning, then fire fills a lane across the room. Step sideways out of the lane, then return to the pickup spot.

steps.title: Phase 3: the landing
steps.text: At 40% she lands in the centre with her threat reset. burst threat her within five seconds, hold still for a moment so she settles on you, then walk backwards to the wall between the cracks.

steps.title: Bellowing Roar
steps.text:
Bellowing Roar fears the whole raid, you included. You will run off her for three seconds.

As soon as the fear ends, get back between her and the raid and walk her onto the wall spot before she turns on them.

steps.title: You are ready
steps.text: That is the whole fight. Try a drill to repeat one mechanic, or run the full fight and look at your scorecard.

cues.notes: Taunt cues shown in the lane above the ability bar. A note lands when a Taunt is due; early/late are the seconds around it that still count.

list.label: Burst threat when she turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment she turns, burst threat. Every second she faces the raid is a Flame Breath waiting to happen.

list.label: Burst threat as she lands
list.tip: Her threat table is empty when she lands. burst threat inside the first seconds, then hold still so she settles on you.

list.label: Pick up the whelps
list.tip: Meet the whelps at the cave mouths and burst threat or run into them before they reach the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a breath coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Pull her to the wall, hold her facing away from the raid, burst threat when she turns on the raid, pick her up when she lands. She cannot be taunted, so threat is everything.

offtank.label: Whelp off-tank
offtank.description: Tank as the main tank does, and in Phase 2 pick up the whelp waves and hold them away from the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay on her flank at the shoulder, clear of the breath cone and the tail, hold your threat under the tank, and spread with the raid in Phase 2.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand in the wall pocket at her flank out of her front and her tail, manage threat, spread 8 yd in Phase 2 and dodge the Deep Breath lanes.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Stand in the wall pocket at her flank within range of the tank, keep the tank up through Flame Breath and the landing, stay out of the lanes.
